items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps the routine gentle and won't strip dry-looking skin.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to add comfort and moisture for skin that looks and feels dry.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides helps shield the look of dark patches from sun and visible light, and mineral filters are a pregnancy-friendly choice.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then apply the tinted SPF last each morning and reapply when outdoors. I haven't added any brightening or exfoliating actives, because please check with your doctor or a dermatologist about whether to keep using your hydroquinone cream while pregnant, and ask them what, if anything, to add for dark patches.
